description: Agent-native CLI for DefiLlama DeFi analytics. SQLite-backed compound queries across TVL, fees, revenue, yields, stablecoins, DEX volume, and 350+ chains.

novel_features.name: Top protocols by chain with per-chain TVL
novel_features.description: Filters protocols by chain using a per-chain TVL breakdown (not the global tvl); excludes CEXs by default. One command replaces N+1 calls to /protocols + /summary/fees/{protocol}.

novel_features.name: Cross-protocol time-series compare
novel_features.description: Side-by-side daily time series across protocols. No single API endpoint provides this; the CLI joins protocol_tvl_hist + fees_hist locally.

novel_features.name: Stablecoin flow
novel_features.description: Per-chain stablecoin supply deltas synthesised from /stablecoincharts/{chain} into stablecoin_hist.

novel_features.name: Read-only SQL escape hatch
novel_features.command: sql "SELECT p.name, p.tvl, f.total_24h_rev, p.change_7d FROM protocols p JOIN fees_overview f ON p.slug = f.protocol WHERE f.total_24h_rev > 50000 AND p.change_7d < -5 ORDER BY f.total_24h_rev DESC LIMIT 15"
novel_features.description: Raw SELECT against the local mirror for questions that don't map to a named command (e.g. high-revenue + declining-TVL value extraction).
